meta._note: The park media library: everything that is not a species photo (those stay in photo_credits.json). One record per item, written by media_intake.py. media_id is permanent and minted by the intake page, never typed. collection is park (the website, screens and signs; Randy's) or bev (her link area, never referenced by a page). The key prefix follows it. files[].key is the permanent address in the bucket; url is rebuilt from it on every upload. Anything not public never reaches the public bucket.
